languages.briefInfo: Plant-care reminders that live on your phone. No account, no paywall.
languages.appDesc:
PlantCue reminds you to water, fertilise and mist your plants — and nothing more.

Add a plant with a photo and a room, set how often it needs care, and PlantCue sends one daily reminder listing everything that is due. Tap Done and the next date moves on; tap Snooze if today is not the day.

Everything stays on your device. There is no account, no cloud, no plant-identification upsell and no trial that turns into a bill.

What you get:
• Watering, fertilising and misting schedules per plant
• Today view with overdue and due plants and one-tap Done
• One daily reminder at the hour you choose
• Plant list with photos, rooms and next-due dates
• Care history and simple stats: on-time rate and streak
• Light, dark and system themes
• Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Turkish, Arabic and Chinese

PlantCue is free and supported by Huawei Petal Ads, shown only on the plant list and stats screens — never while you add or care for a plant.
languages.newFeatures: Initial release: per-plant watering, fertilising and misting schedules, daily reminder, care history and stats. Fully offline, no account required.
